add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.reason: On keycloak/keycloak main today, misc/theme-verifier/.../VerifyMessageProperties.java still declares ANCHOR_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("</?a[^>]*>") (and HTML_TAGS "<[a-z]+[^>]*>") with no CASE_INSENSITIVE flag, and santizeAnchors still only strips anchors matched by it. POLICY_SOME_HTML still allows only br/p/strong/b/formattedLink (no anchors), so an uppercase <A ...> identical in English and translation survives santizeAnchors, gets stripped by the sanitizer and reported as 'Illegal HTML'. The 10 later commits to the file (2025-02-23 to 2026-01-20) add other validations (blanks, quotes, placeholders, curly braces, discouraged words) and do not touch the anchor/HTML patterns.
